title: phaseolus nelsonii
intro: Phaseolus nelsonii, commonly known as the Nelson bean, is a species of wild bean native to the southwestern United States. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus nelsonii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of this plant.
